description: Hierarchical Knowledge Distillation and Neural Architecture Search Framework for Lightweight Multimodal Medical Diagnosis on Edge Devices

innovations.name: EA-NAS
innovations.expected_behavior: Constructs continuous heterogeneous search space with computational cost penalty term to evolve optimal multimodal fusion topology

disabled_by.note: Replaces search space with static conv

innovations.name: HKD
innovations.full_name: Hierarchical Knowledge Distillation with Cross-modal Relation Alignment
innovations.expected_behavior: Aligns teacher-student cross-modal covariance matrices via Frobenius norm + KL divergence distillation

disabled_by.note: Uses only CE loss without relation/KL alignment

innovations.name: DFC
innovations.expected_behavior: Handles modality missing via SNR-based masking, cross-modal generation, and adaptive gating fusion

disabled_by.note: Bypasses DFC, uses raw features directly

teacher_model.name: TeacherModel
teacher_model.architecture: ViT-B/32 + TabNet-style EHR encoder + Cross-modal Fusion
teacher_model.note: Dominant cost is the ViT-B/32 image encoder (~86M). The full-scale 312M budget described in the paper (TabNet ~51M + fusion ~175M) is reproduced with lightweight MLP components; see models/teacher_model.py.

loss_config.joint_loss: L_Total = L_Distill + lambda * log(FLOPs(alpha)) + rho * L_Recon
